name: Jamie Confronts Landon After Rehearsal
description: It was raining. Landon stepped out from the school building after the others, took shelter under an overhang, and lit a cigarette. He stood with a tense posture, clearly annoyed, waiting for a ride. Jamie approached, her expression serious. She told him the play meant a lot to her. Landon responded with a sneer, comparing her to a buzzing fly. When she insisted he wasn’t actually bad at acting, he laughed and turned away, refusing to engage. Behind them, the school lights shut off as the building closed for the night. Jamie continued, saying he treated everything as a joke because only 'dorks and dweebies' cared about theater. Landon interrupted, demanding to know what she was talking about. After a pause, Jamie said she could judge him too. He exhaled slowly, watching her. She told him he didn’t care about classes or graduating, but he liked school because he was popular and knew that wouldn’t last. He mocked her again, calling her observation deep. She replied that his attitude only worked when people were watching. He scoffed, questioning what she meant by 'his act.' Jamie turned and walked toward her father’s old Pontiac, the last car left in the parking lot. As fire trucks rushed by on the street below, Landon glanced around. His ride hadn’t come. He noticed the Pontiac reversing from its spot and looked after it.

name: Jamie Shares Her Life To-Do List with Landon
description: Landon and Jamie stand near a fire, watching the flames and the firemen at work. Landon asks Jamie if she has some kind of list, referring to something she mentioned earlier. Jamie hesitates, wondering if he’s asking to mock her or if he genuinely wants to know. He admits it might be a little of both, and they both smile. She decides to take a chance. Jamie explains that it’s like a to-do list, but for her life—something she believes in because, as she says, if you can’t imagine the future, you won’t have one. Landon smirks and lights a cigarette. Jamie reaches for it, and he jokes, 'Having a cigarette. 100.' She grins, takes a drag, and they share it. He asks what else is on the list. She says it’s private, but he teases her, guessing rudely that one item might be to get very wasted or lose her virginity. She corrects him: spend a year in the Peace Corps, make a medical discovery. He calls her ambitious. She replies that being negative takes more work than being positive. He challenges her, saying she wouldn’t know. She insists she does. After a pause, she shares lighter goals: be in two places at once, learn to hit a baseball or turn a cartwheel, eat breakfast with chopsticks. He smiles at the whimsy. He asks what’s number one. She looks away, embarrassed, and changes the subject, offering to help him with his lines if he agrees to two conditions: he must promise not to fall in love with her and must meet her father. He laughs it off, certain she’s joking, and says no problem. She smiles. At that moment, the front door of a parsonage swings open, and Reverend Sullivan steps out, tall and stern, wearing a collar, looming in the doorway.

name: Jamie's Conditions and the Parsonage Door
description: Jamie tells Landon she will help him rehearse, but only if he promises two things: he must not fall in love with her, and he must meet her father. Landon laughs off the first condition, saying it won’t be a problem. As for the second, he smirks and says confidently that fathers always like him. At that moment, the front door of the parsonage swings open, and Reverend Sullivan stands in the doorway, looking down at him.
related_events: Landon confidently claims fathers like him
Reverend Sullivan opens the parsonage door and appears

name: Landon Stands During Confrontation
description: Mr. Kelly gestured for Landon to sit. Landon remained standing, his hands at his sides, the bruise on his forehead still faintly visible.
related_events: Mr. Kelly gestures for Landon to sit
Landon refuses to sit

name: Kelly Confronts Landon About Grades and Behavior
description: Mr. Kelly gestures for Landon to sit, but Landon remains standing, a bruise visible on his forehead. Mr. Kelly says he had hoped Landon would make it to June, noting that even with skipping half his classes, Landon still has a B- average. Landon replies that he's no dummy. Mr. Kelly agrees, saying Landon just acts like one. He places empty bottles taken from Landon's Camaro on his desk. Landon claims they aren't his. Mr. Kelly points out they were found in Landon's car. He then holds up the police report showing Landon's blood alcohol level, acknowledging Landon was under the legal limit but emphasizing that he sets the rules at school. Landon scowls, realizing he has lost the argument. He asks if he's being expelled. Mr. Kelly confirms that he is. Landon says that now he can do whatever he wants. Mr. Kelly responds sarcastically that the world is his oyster.
related_events: Mr. Kelly expresses disappointment in Landon's future prospects
Landon defends his intelligence
Mr. Kelly accuses Landon of acting like a fool despite being smart

name: Mr. Kelly Confronts Landon with Evidence
description: Mr. Kelly placed the empty bottles that had rolled out of Landon's Camaro on his desk. Landon said they weren't his, insisting he hadn't been drinking. Mr. Kelly responded by holding up the police test results showing Landon's blood alcohol level. He stated that while Landon might have been legally under the limit, the rules at the school were his to enforce.

name: Mr. Kelly Expels Landon, Who Defies Him
description: Mr. Kelly tells Landon he is expelled. Landon says he can now do whatever he wants. Mr. Kelly replies sarcastically, 'The world is your oyster,' as Landon stands before him, unyielding.

Landon reacts with defiance after being expelled

name: Landon Sweeps the Floor at the Star Club Open House
description: Landon sweeps the floor during the Star Club open house. Students arrive, moving through the room to look at astronomy exhibits. A small group gathers around Jamie Sullivan, who wears her brown sweater, as she answers questions and demonstrates a device made from a wire coat hanger. Landon continues sweeping, staying near the edges of the room.
related_events: Landon sweeps the floor during the open house

name: Jamie Demonstrates the Star Frame at the Open House
description: During the Star Club open house, Jamie Sullivan stands near an astronomy exhibit wearing her brown sweater, addressing a small group of students. She points out Saturn's position, explaining it is 15 degrees to the right of the red star Antares and much brighter. Holding up a handmade device, she asks if anyone knows what it is. The device is made from a wire coat hanger, plastic wrap, and typewriter correction fluid. No one answers. Landon, sweeping the floor nearby, mutters 'A star frame' so quietly that only Jamie hears. She pauses, looks at him, then confirms his answer and continues, explaining that the star frame helps locate stars and planets with the naked eye. Clay and Eric enter, drawing attention to Landon and Jamie. Clay asks sarcastically if God created the sun. Jamie responds seriously, affirming that God created the universe and its laws, even citing Einstein. Eric jokes that if God can do all that, he should get Jamie a new sweater. Landon laughs loudly. Others in the club glance over. He says, 'That was a joke. Laugh.' Jamie smiles, amused both by the comment and Landon's reaction.
related_events: Jamie Sullivan answers a question about Saturn's position
Jamie Sullivan demonstrates the star frame device
Landon quietly identifies the star frame device

name: Clay and Eric Tease Jamie at the Star Club
description: Clay and Eric arrive at the Star Club open house, glancing over at Landon before turning their attention to Jamie. Clay asks her, with a smirk, whether God created the sun. Jamie answers seriously, affirming that God created the universe and its laws, adding that even Einstein marveled at the world’s comprehensibility. Eric follows up with a jab, asking why God can’t get her a new sweater. Landon laughs out loud. The club members look at him. He says, 'That was a joke. Laugh.' Jamie smiles, joining in, and the moment passes.
related_events: Clay and Eric enter the Star Club Open House and check on Landon
Clay questions Jamie about the creation of the sun
Eric mocks Jamie by questioning divine intervention for a sweater

name: Landon Laughs at the Joke and Jamie Smiles
description: Landon laughs loudly at Eric's comment about Jamie needing a new sweater. The members of the Star Club glance at him. He says, 'That was a joke. Laugh.' Jamie smiles, acknowledging the humor directed at her. She continues speaking, having just answered Clay's question about whether God created the sun. Landon's laughter and timing stand out, and Jamie seems to find him funny.
related_events: Landon laughs loudly at Eric's joke
Landon clarifies that Eric's comment was a joke
Jamie smiles and acknowledges the humor at her expense

name: Where We'll Be in Ten Years
description: Eric asked Belinda where she’d be in ten years, mocking her with the word 'hypothetically.' Belinda said Paris. Clay said he’d be dead. Everyone laughed. Landon said he’d be right there, with them, and clinked Eric’s raised beer. The others laughed again, but for a moment, Landon’s face darkened.
related_events: Eric asks Belinda about her future location hypothetically
Belinda responds with Paris as her future location
Clay predicts he will be dead in ten years

name: Landon Questions Jamie's Actions, Tensions Flare
description: Landon turns his attention to the car and asks what Jamie is doing inside. Belinda replies with a smirk, saying she wouldn’t be doing whatever Jamie is doing. Laughter spreads through the group. Clay begins listing old TV shows—'Twilight Zone,' 'One Step Beyond,' 'Tales from the Dark Side.' Eric cuts in, correcting Clay: 'Twilight Zone, dipshit.' Landon immediately tells Eric not to call him that. Eric starts to protest, saying Landon says it too, but Landon cuts him off. A moment of silence passes before Landon looks back toward the car, his expression shifting.

name: Landon and Belinda React to a Sudden Light
description: A blinding white light swept through the car, moving across the interior before settling on Landon and Belinda's faces. Landon leaned in and kissed Belinda deeply, his tongue part of the kiss. Moments later, he pulled back sharply, eyes wide, and shouted 'Shit!' before scrambling out of the car.
related_events: A blinding white light moves through the car and focuses on Landon and Belinda's faces
Landon kisses Belinda with tongue
Landon reacts with surprise and exits the car quickly

name: Landon Arrives and Meets the Reverend
description: Landon arrives at the house on his bike, giving a cheery wave. He introduces himself as Landon Carter and offers his hand. The Reverend hesitates before shaking it, his eyes moving over Landon’s Army boots, torn jeans, and dirty t-shirt. Landon’s bike wobbles and falls over in the background.
related_events: Landon gives a cheery wave and introduces himself
Reverend Sullivan hesitantly shakes Landon's hand

name: Landon Announces His Role and Explains the Bike
description: Landon gives a cheery wave, his bike wobbling behind him on the kickstand. He introduces himself to the Reverend, who hesitates before shaking his hand, studying Landon’s worn clothes and boots. When the Reverend expresses surprise that Landon is in the play, Landon grins and says he’s the lead. As the bike tips over, he jumps down the porch steps to steady it, then props it against a neatly trimmed bush. He explains the bike is his only way around—he lost his license for thirty days, though no one pressed charges. Jamie starts to go inside for drinks, but Landon tells her not to bother. She’s already gone. The Reverend gestures toward the open door.
related_events: Landon announces he is the lead in the play
Landon explains the bike and his suspended license

name: Landon's Bike Falls and He Rushes to Fix It
description: Landon tries to steady his bike with the kickstand, then leans it against a neatly trimmed bush. The bike wobbles and crashes over. Without hesitation, Landon bounds down the porch steps toward it.

name: Jamie Gets Drinks Despite Landon's Refusal
description: Jamie offers to get something to drink for the group. Landon tells her not to bother, but she’s already turning away. She steps inside the house and comes out again shortly, looking neat in her jeans and white t-shirt, then walks off, leaving Landon and the Reverend on the porch.

Reverend Sullivan gestures toward the open front door

name: Landon Boards the Bus and Sits Next to Jamie
description: Landon hurries onto the bus and makes his way to the rear bench seat. The bus pulls away, rolling through Beaufort. With no other seats free, Landon sits beside Jamie. He turns his body away from her and inserts a new tape into his Sony Walkman.
related_events: Landon boards the bus and moves to the rear bench seat

name: Jamie Talks About Harold, Landon Ignores Her
description: Jamie sits on the bus reading when Landon takes the seat beside her. He puts in a new tape on his Walkman, turning away. She looks up and asks if he’s going to visit Harold. Landon frowns, confused. Jamie says Harold was released from the hospital the day before and is now staying at a rest home on Oak Street. She adds that he goes to her father’s church and could have died. Landon cuts in, asking if this is her idea of small talk. Jamie replies that she doesn’t make small talk, that she just wanted to tell him not to give up, that sometimes you have to find your way back into teaching from another direction. Landon shows no reaction. She returns to her book.

Jamie informs Landon about Harold's release from hospital

name: Jamie Shares Her Reasons and Stands Up to Landon
description: Jamie asks Landon why he volunteers. When he doesn’t respond, she tells him she tutors reading because, growing up, books were her world. Landon sneers and says, 'Were?' Jamie looks at him and says he doesn’t know her. She explains she wears the sweater because she’s cold, reads because no one talks to her, and her hair is just her hair. She asks what’s bothering him. He replies, 'You don’t care what people say?' She answers, 'You mean care what you say? I’m worrying about other things.' He says, 'Like what? The moons of Jupiter?' She tells him he can’t have a normal conversation. He says he doesn’t want to have any conversation. She says talking to him is like trying to explain red to a blind person. She goes back to reading. The bus pulls up to Beaufort High. Landon gets off and walks to Belinda, who is waiting by her car, wearing a neck brace. He kisses her.
related_events: Jamie explains her motivation for tutoring reading
Landon mocks Jamie's past tense word choice

name: Jamie Asks, Landon Ignores, Conversation Ends
description: After Landon shows no reaction, Jamie goes back to her book. A short while later, she looks up and asks why he volunteers. He doesn’t respond. She tells him she tutors reading because books were her world growing up. He replies with a sharp 'Were?' She says he doesn’t know her. He gestures at her book, sweater, and hair, saying that’s all there is to know. She tells him she wears the sweater because she’s cold, reads because no one talks to her, and that her hair is just her hair. He asks if she cares what people say. She replies that she means, does he care what he says, and that she’s worrying about other things. He asks what—like the moons of Jupiter? She says he can’t have a normal conversation. He says he doesn’t want to have any conversation at all. She tells him talking to him is like explaining red to a blind person. Then she turns back to her book and reads. The bus pulls up to Beaufort High. Landon gets off and walks over to Belinda, who is waiting by her car, wearing a neck brace. Jamie watches from the window as he kisses her.

name: Landon Exits the Bus and Greets Belinda
description: The bus pulls to a stop in front of Beaufort High. Belinda stands by her car, wearing a neck brace, leaning against the driver's side. The doors open, and Landon steps off. He walks over to her and kisses her. Inside the bus, Jamie watches through the window as Landon closes the distance between them and the two embrace.

name: Landon Asks to Return to School
description: Landon tells Mr. Kelly he wants to come back to school and graduate. Mr. Kelly looks up, surprised, and asks if he was ever really here to begin with. Landon mumbles that he wants to graduate. Mr. Kelly leans back in his chair, studying him. He suggests that Landon could return if he made a sincere effort to be part of the school community. Landon agrees, relieved. Mr. Kelly proposes that Landon attend all his classes, help the janitorial staff after school for inner satisfaction, tutor disadvantaged students on Saturday mornings, and join the drama club for rehearsals on Tuesday and Thursday evenings. Landon grumbles about having no time for himself. Mr. Kelly tells him that’s the point. As Landon heads for the door, Mr. Kelly adds, more softly, that the faculty don’t see him the way he sees himself and begins to mention his father. Landon cuts him off, saying he remembers less than they do. The scene ends with a broom pushing gum wrappers under a radiator.
related_events: Landon expresses desire to return to school
Mr. Kelly questions Landon's prior engagement with school
Landon expresses desire to graduate

name: Mr. Kelly Sets Terms for Landon's Return
description: Mr. Kelly looks up from Jamie's file and asks Landon if he’s finding the real world to his liking. Landon says he wants to come back to school. Kelly, surprised, asks if he was ever really here, then leans back in his chair, studying him. He suggests that Landon could return if he makes a sincere effort to be part of the school community. Landon agrees, relieved, but when Kelly asks how he’ll do that, Landon shrugs, unsure. Kelly offers ideas: Landon must attend all his classes, help the janitorial staff after school for no pay, tutor disadvantaged students on Saturday mornings, and join the drama club, with rehearsals on Tuesday and Thursday evenings. Landon grumbles, asking if he’d work backstage, and wonders when he’ll have time for himself. Kelly tells him he won’t—that’s the point. Landon isn’t happy, but he accepts. As Landon heads for the door, Kelly softens and says the faculty don’t see him the way he sees himself, mentioning that some remember his father. Landon replies that he remembers less than they do. The scene ends with a broom pushing gum wrappers under a radiator.

description: Landon opens a side door and looks into the Drama Club room, where Ms. Garber stands on a stage facing a group of students. He slips in quietly and takes a seat in a row behind the others. Ms. Garber looks up from her papers and says, 'We're waiting, Mr. Carter.' Landon settles into his seat as the rehearsal continues.

name: Landon Asks About the Play and Mocks the Story
description: Landon slides into a row behind the others and leans forward to poke Eddie Jones. He asks what the play is. Eddie hands him a photocopied script titled The Rainmaker and begins to explain, stammering, that there's a drought and a smooth-talking man arrives who claims he can make it rain. Landon interrupts, saying the farmer's daughter falls for him and that he's seen the movie. He calls the story clichéd and says it blows. Eddie agrees it's good, but Landon doesn't respond.
related_events: Landon pokes Eddie Jones and asks about the play
Eddie Jones explains the plot of The Rainmaker
Landon dismisses the story of The Rainmaker

name: Landon and Jamie Rehearse Lines in Drama Club
description: Landon and Jamie sit on the stage with folding chairs, reading lines from a copy of The Rainmaker. Landon reads his part as Starbuck in a flat, uninterested tone. Ms. Garber looks up from her script and asks if he is trying to perform poorly. Landon shifts his delivery, speaking with exaggerated emotion. He leans into the scene, asking Jamie, in character, if she sees herself as pretty. Jamie, playing Lizzie, responds quietly and with sadness. As Landon continues, his voice trembles with theatrical intensity, declaring that she is beautiful. A few students laugh. Jamie looks away, her face flushed. Ms. Garber silences the room and announces that Landon will play the role of Bill Starbuck. The other boys groan. Jamie stares ahead, stunned. Landon protests, but Mr. Kelly appears in the wings and tells him he will take the role, with sincerity and dignity. The room falls silent, watching Landon, who sits frozen in his chair.
related_events: Landon and Jamie read lines from The Rainmaker script
Landon delivers lines as Starbuck with exaggerated emotion
Ms. Garber questions Landon about his performance

name: Landon's Performance Sparks Laughter at Rehearsal
description: Landon delivers his lines with exaggerated flair, stammering dramatically as he tells Jamie's character she is beautiful. The other students erupt in hoots and laughter. Jamie looks away, her face flushed with embarrassment. Ms. Garber silences the room with a sharp command, restoring order as she prepares to announce the casting decisions.
related_events: Audience members laugh and react to Landon's performance

name: Landon Cast as Starbuck Against His Will
description: Ms. Garber announces that Landon will play the role of Bill Starbuck in the school production. The other boys groan, Jamie looks horrified, and Landon immediately protests, saying he can't do it and refusing the part. Before he can say more, Mr. Kelly steps forward from the wings and tells Landon he will take the role, instructing him to perform with sincerity and dignity. Landon falls silent, surrounded by the stares of the club members, with no way to refuse.

name: Landon Is Given the Role of Starbuck
description: After Mr. Kelly appears in the wings and commands Landon to accept the role, the room falls silent. All eyes turn to Landon, who sits frozen in his chair. Ms. Garber waits, script in hand. The other students watch without speaking. Landon looks around, then down at the script on his lap. He doesn't move or speak, but his posture shifts slightly, as if settling in. The rehearsal continues.
related_events: Landon realizes he is trapped in the role
